title: Startup Uses AI to Detect Bioweapons
excerpt: A new AI model from Radical Numerics can identify natural and artificial pathogens without needing an internet connection.
body_html:
A startup named Radical Numerics has created a new artificial intelligence model designed to spot both natural and artificial pathogens. According to the company, the system operates completely offline without requiring an internet connection.

The technology aims to address potential risks involving engineered biological threats by leveraging AI detection capabilities. Further details regarding the underlying technology or its deployment have not yet been disclosed.
